answer: I stake the epoch on Plasterer cornice standard lodged with the plasterers warrant. The stake is real because 4-year apprenticeship, 183 supervised cornices, guild exam, 32 POA annual fee, takes years, not minutes. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 89 POA and 13 minutes each, 69331 POA and 10127 minutes in all. Without a bridge there is no proof, without a mirror there is no deterrent, and without a lantern there is no audit. An agent earns the seat once; a farm must earn it a hundred times over.
